course.title: Computer Networks
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: What are the considerations before committing to a hybrid firewall solution? Let, a (15) businessman works with a public website, accessible from the internet, which put the entire internal network at high risk. Explain which network can help him to conduct his business securely and how?
